text: Say if you don't let your anger out. If you just push it down and try to get rid of your anger because you don't want to lose your temper. Because if you lose your temper, you'll lose your credibility at work or you'll lose your credibility with other people. So just push it down. But the articles, the scholarly articles say that suppression of anger actually can bring about cardiovascular damage, can damage relationships and your emotional health. That burying your anger isn't really best. David Palisson was a Christian counselor and he said that.
